differences: The only visible difference is the color of the "Edit" label in the bottom button row: in A23D it is a neutral gray/white matching "Cancel", while in 6A2E it is rendered in a purple/blue accent color, distinct from "Cancel".
In A23D, Cancel and Edit share the same neutral text color, so the orange "送る" button is the only colored element besides the header link.
In 6A2E, there are two accent colors present in the button row (purple Edit, orange 送る), whereas A23D has only one accent color (orange) among the three buttons.
All other elements (header, title, 宛先/差出人 fields, message body, 出所 line, spacing/layout) appear identical between the two images.
notes: Difference is limited to Edit's text color; A23D keeps a single-accent hierarchy while 6A2E gives Edit its own color to differentiate it from Cancel.
